What Is Immediate Matrix?

Immediate Matrix is an easy-to-use website that works as an intermediary between people willing to learn more about investments and companies that can teach them about this topic.

Created by individuals passionate about investments, this website addresses a common issue that affects most people who want to engage in this activity: a lack of knowledge. Immediate Matrix can make a difference when it comes to learning about investments. While it won’t offer instruction itself, this website creates a connection between users and investment education firms. As such, it makes it easier for people to find what they need to expand their knowledge about this activity.

Moreover, this website is quick and simple to navigate. If you don’t have experience, you can still sign up and get paired with an investment education firm in just minutes. In a nutshell, Immediate Matrix offers an easy way to connect with an investment education firm, helping people kick-start their learning journey.

What Is Investing?

Although people may engage in this activity for different reasons, the main definition of “investing” is putting resources into a good or service to try and capitalize on market movements. However, many fail to take advantage of these fluctuations and end up losing their hard-earned money due to the risks that often affect investment products.

The Investment Options Most People Put Their Money Into

When it comes to choosing a type of investment to add to a portfolio, there’s a myriad of options. All of these products and services are different and may have a unique effect on investors' collections. Therefore, it’s essential to evaluate each one, considering essential aspects such as their risk level, before making a decision. These are the most popular and the ones people should learn more about:

Cryptocurrencies

Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies drove the world crazy. As soon as they appeared, everyone started talking about these tokens. At first, they were designed as new forms of payment. However, many started investing in these assets. Unfortunately, they’re highly risky and have led to significant monetary losses.

Mutual Funds

A mutual fund is a pooled collection, which means that several people put their resources into it. Additionally, this portfolio holds multiple assets, granting a portion of them to each holder.

Ordinary people don’t run these investment vehicles. Instead, they’re managed by professionals. However, they’re risky like other options you may consider.

Forex

Forex or “foreign exchange trading” is another popular option among people who want to jump into this world. However, it isn’t an asset but an activity. FX trading involves exchanging one global currency for another when there are market movements to try and capitalize on them. This makes this practice highly risky.

Main Differences Between Investing and Trading

If you’re looking for information about investments, you’ll probably hear about “trading.” This is a similar practice that people also engage in to try and capitalize on market movements.

Both activities are also vulnerable to certain risks that can result in monetary losses and require people to put resources into particular assets. However, although both terms are often used interchangeably, the truth is that “trading” and “investing” are two completely different things. These are some of the differences between them:

  • Traders often choose assets that are more complex than the products investors add to their portfolios. That means trading could be riskier than investing.
  • Another thing that makes trading riskier is the time horizon. As it’s shorter, traders tend to be more impulsive when making decisions. Contrastingly, some investors tend to focus on building long-term portfolios.
  • Trades are usually subject to high capital gain taxes. However, how investments are taxed usually varies depending on the type you choose.

What Are the Risks That May Affect Investments?

As mentioned, all investment types are vulnerable to risks. Any product or service you may put your resources into could suddenly lose value due to multiple factors or events. Therefore, you should dedicate a phase of your learning process to understanding them better.

These are the four most common risks when it comes to investing:

Market Risk

These risks are those that impact the entire market, although they mainly affect specific assets such as stocks and options. They’re caused by external factors that impact all asset prices, such as changes in the economy, foreign exchange fluctuations, rising interest rates, the geopolitical situation, and more.

Inflation Risk

As the inflation rate rises, the purchasing power of a currency can fall. More often than not, this also causes a value drop in most assets. Additionally, rising inflation can result in products and services losing value over time, possibly causing monetary losses and affecting people’s ability to acquire or exchange their investments.

Liquidity Risk

This risk comes from the lack of marketability of an asset, which means it cannot be acquired or exchanged quickly at a given time. In these cases, holders aren’t able to prevent or minimize losses because the product or service cannot be marketed. In fact, many end up accepting offers below their actual value.

Concentration Risk

Some people also experience significant monetary losses when they fail to diversify their portfolios. This is known as “concentration risk” and refers to the possible value drops that a collection can experience if all or a large portion of the resources are allocated towards a single investment type and this exposure moves in an unfavorable direction.

What People Should Know About Investments

Education won’t eliminate investment risks nor will it guarantee asset holders will achieve the results they expect. Actually, nothing can do it. However, learning about this activity is essential if you want to be able to make informed decisions about your resources and have extensive knowledge under your belt to deal with the things this universe brings. In this regard, investment education has become a crucial part of the journey of people who plan to explore this world. These are some of the reasons why it’s important:

  • During your learning process, you’ll be able to define your needs and expectations regarding your portfolio and plans, which will guide you down the road.
  • If you commit to educating yourself about investments, you’ll learn more about the different products and services to invest into. In addition, being able to evaluate each one to choose those that are suitable for one’s portfolio according to their needs and preferences.
  • When users understand how investments work and create a plan using the information above, they are prepared to set their time horizon. That means they can decide how long to hold their assets.
  • Finally, through comprehensive education, understanding what is happening in the market is easier. Users may be able to monitor the performance of certain assets before making a decision about their collection.

Is Educating Yourself About Investments Necessary?

Learning about investments isn’t mandatory. If you want to explore this world, you aren’t required to do so. However, if you fail to educate yourself about this activity, you could face many issues in the future.

Investments are risky by nature. This means anyone who engages in this activity could end up losing their hard-earned money. Additionally, you should learn many things to hopefully make well-educated decisions and avoid mistakes that could also put you in a tough situation.

This has made education crucial for everyone interested in investments, even those who aren’t new to this world. People understand that expanding their knowledge is non-negotiable when it comes to engaging in an activity that could result in them losing their resources. Although it isn’t a way to prevent assets from losing value or guarantee that investments will help users achieve positive results, many prioritize education because it’s a powerful resource to equip themselves with the knowledge necessary to learn the ropes and gain confidence when exploring the investment universe.

What Can an Investment Education Firm Do?

An investment education firm can offer multiple educational services to people who need help learning about this activity. Most of these companies provide guidance through their representatives, who teach users about investment-related topics. Although each firm you can get paired with is different, most of them usually offer the same things. These are some examples of those offerings:

  • Educational resources to help people expand their investment knowledge, such as eBooks, videos, virtual courses, podcasts, and more
  • Guides on specific topics, such as the most common asset types, popular portfolio diversification techniques, and more
  • Market analysis tools to monitor the performance of an asset or the market
  • Seminars and workshops people can join in to learn more about investments
